engine.notLoaded: Shown when the shared service is unavailable.

folder.saveToTooltip: Receive folder action or validation. %1 = full receive folder path.
folder.useDownloadsTooltip: Receive folder action or validation. %1 = custom receive folder path.

chooser.sendFolder: Native file chooser title or launch error.
chooser.saveTo: Native file chooser title or launch error.
chooser.notStarted: Native file chooser title or launch error.
chooser.notOpened: Native file chooser title or launch error.
clipboard.imageFailed: Error when Send clipboard cannot save the picture (for example a screenshot) on the clipboard to send it.
helper.repairMissing: Helper recovery/version panel. %1 = literal update command.
helper.versions: Helper recovery/version panel. %1 = required version; %2 = installed version.
helper.unavailableDetail: Helper recovery/version panel. %1 = translated Retry helper label; %2 = literal ./build.sh command.
incoming.wantsToSend: Incoming approval prompt. %1 = remote sender alias.
incoming.moreRequests: Incoming approval prompt. %1 = localized count of queued requests.
transfer.andMore: Transfer summary/progress/result. %1 = first remote filename; %2 = localized remaining file count.
transfer.progressTo: Transfer summary/progress/result. %1 = localized percentage without percent sign; %2 = destination alias.
transfer.progressFrom: Transfer summary/progress/result. %1 = localized percentage without percent sign; %2 = sender alias.
transfer.speed: Second progress line under the percentage while sending or receiving. %1 is a formatted size such as 12 MB, so %1/s is a speed; %2 is a duration from the transfer.fewSeconds, transfer.seconds, transfer.minutes or transfer.hoursMinutes entries.
transfer.fewSeconds: Time left in a transfer, used as %2 of transfer.speed, when under ten seconds remain.
transfer.seconds: Time left in a transfer, used as %2 of transfer.speed. %1 is a number of seconds. Use the short unit symbol so no plural form is needed.
transfer.minutes: Time left in a transfer, used as %2 of transfer.speed. %1 is a number of minutes. Use the short unit symbol so no plural form is needed.
transfer.hoursMinutes: Time left in a transfer, used as %2 of transfer.speed. %1 is hours and %2 minutes. Use short unit symbols so no plural form is needed.
